title: Triage traces a record sentence's first commit with --full-history
why: At 08:35 CST Nov 8 triage cited batch 23 (#840, 6ddcf3406) as where a project-ops sentence landed. Plain `git log -S` simplified merge history and showed the merge; the sentence first appears in 17e9675c0 (2026-10-26). Lane role-ids-in-brief caught it at 09:07 CST. A wrong first commit can turn a ruling trace the wrong way.
note: Fix: triage's ruling-trace method (premise P44, and the waiting-page skill's past-ruling check) runs `git log --full-history -S '<sentence>' -- <record>` and cites the oldest commit. Done check: the skill text names --full-history. Filed by triage 09:09 CST Nov 8.
